hints.title: Path Traversal Identification
hints.text: For each query (u, v, target), find the unique simple path between nodes u and v in the tree.

hints.title: Measuring Distance to Target
hints.text: Compute distances from target to all nodes on the path using breadth traversal or tree depth metrics.

hints.title: Minimum Distance Node Selection
hints.text: Pick the node on the simple path with the minimum distance to the target.

hints.title: Tree Path Distance Evaluation Implementation

complexity.notes: Precomputing all-pairs shortest paths on small n gives quick constant checks per query.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rebuilding paths dynamically without precomputed distances repeats redundant tree traversals.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Distance matrix of size n x n stores tree hop counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies node on path criterion: dist(u, x) + dist(x, v) == dist(u, v).
